name: アカミ🎀お絵かき妖怪
description: Vチューバー配信を見るのが大好きな妖怪です/SDキャラ・FAを描いたり 個人ご依頼もおこなっております。ご依頼は初心者さんも大歓迎です٩( 'ω' )وskeb→https://skeb.jp/@cJKKCqQMvP　お気軽にフォローしてください

works.body:
Dear Dr. Akami

My name is AI.
I would like to request you to draw an illustration of Kinako Kashii, a forest diva and mushroom-based personal Vtuber, in her new costume (announced on December 1, 2024).
As we have requested before, we would like you to use your very cute and wonderful drawings to depict Kinako Kashii in her new costume singing in a cool, cute, and mysterious way.
We would be very happy if you could depict the coolness and mystique of Kinako Kashii in a cute and charming manner, and motivate her to sing in the song frame.
There are no three-sided drawings, and there are various differences, but we would like to ask you to use any combination you like.
(Personally, I would be happy if you could draw all of them in full, or if it would be too complicated, in the simplest form.)

[Intended use.
As a gift to Ms. Kinako Kashii herself.
Thumbnails for our monetized Youtube channel
Thumbnails for our monetized Youtube channel.

Image
We may have asked for a lot of details above, but we would appreciate it if you could draw the image freely in the world of Ms. Akami, with expressions and compositions that are not cute or cool. We would appreciate it if you could add a microphone as well, since we are planning to use it in a singing frame.


Reference materials
https://x.com/kinako_kashii/status/1863216351399342474

Requests
We would appreciate it if you could do the following so that we can easily use them as thumbnails.
At least the left, right and top are not cut off.
PSDs (or transparent PNGs of each) with the background and characters layered.

If the price is not acceptable, please resend.
Thank you in advance for your cooperation.

Dear Dr. Akami

Thank you for your continued support.
My name is AI.
Thank you very much for drawing the wonderful work of V-tuber Kinako Kashii the other day.

I was so impressed by the wonderful work of the above-mentioned artist that I requested you to draw an illustration for my personal use (I still do not have a fixed one, which I felt inconvenient).
I would be very grateful if you could draw the following profile picture/icon of my own personal favorite application in your very nice taste.

I would like to use them for the following purposes.
I would like to use it as my profile picture and icon on several SNS (X, YouTube, fanbox, etc.). Therefore, only the illustration from the neck up is acceptable. The format of the data to be delivered should be any format that would not be a problem even for an amateur like me.

Image
The illustration should be a pop, slightly handsome "Kuya Shonin" (see reference below) type figure with a mushroom growing on his head (without hair) and six mushrooms of various kinds coming out of his mouth (✕ spitting out), like the "Kuya Shonin" image. The mushrooms on the head should be similar to the mushrooms that grow on Kinako Kashii's original free material character "Shiitake-kun" (see reference below). As for the type of mushrooms that come out of the mouth, we would like you to draw the characteristic types of mushrooms: safflower mushroom, kaentake mushroom, honshimeji mushroom, matsutake mushroom, kinugasa mushroom, and eringi mushroom. However, any kind of mushrooms will be fine as long as you draw something that reflects your taste and looks good.

We would like to leave it up to you to decide whether you want the overall atmosphere to be cute and pop or dubious. We would appreciate it if you could freely draw it as you wish in your own worldview.

Reference materials
Standing Kuya Shonin
https://www.tnm.jp/modules/r_free_page/index.php?id=2129

Shiitake-kun
https://lit.link/KinakoKashii
(There is an image of Shiitake-kun at the bottom of the page.)

If the amount of money, etc. does not seem to be sufficient, please resend the request.
Thank you in advance.

Dear Dr. Akami

My name is AI.
I would like to request you to draw an illustration of Kinako Kashii, an individual Vtuber of mushrooms.
I would like you to draw Kinako Kashii singing in a cool and cute way with your very cute and wonderful drawings.
We would like to see her singing in a cute and charming way (powerful and interesting, but with a bit of a shadow). If this is a difficult request, we would appreciate it if you could draw a work that would motivate Kinako Kashii to sing.

Intended use.
As a gift to Ms. Kinako Kashii herself.
Thumbnails for her monetized Youtube channel
Posting on social networking sites such as X

Image
We may have asked for a lot of details above, but we would appreciate it if you could draw freely in the world of Ms. Akami, except for the expressions and composition, etc., which should be cute and cool.


Reference materials
(three-sided drawing, etc.)
https://x.com/kinako_kashii/status/1742885558253416946

Requests
We would appreciate it if you could do the following so that we can easily use them as thumbnails.
At least the left, right and top are not cut off.
PSDs (or transparent PNGs of each) with the background and characters layered.

If the price is not acceptable, please resend.
Thank you in advance for your cooperation.

Dear Akami, it is nice to meet you.
I would like to make a request to draw an original SD character.

We would like you to draw a boy SD character with a cat and rice cakes as motifs.
We would like the hair style to be like Vtuber Kano's, and the hair color to be a light blue.
https://twitter.com/Kanae_2434/status/1662261546989539328

Other than that, everything else is up to you. I would like you to draw a character that you think is cute.
The illustration will be used as the icon for X.

Thank you for your consideration.
